from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
ROUTES = ROOT / "modules/comercial/routes.py"


def _function_block(text: str, name: str, next_marker: str) -> str:
    start = text.index(name)
    end = text.index(next_marker, start)
    return text[start:end]


def test_dashboard_hoy_uses_mexico_timezone():
    text = ROUTES.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    block = _function_block(
        text,
        "async def comercial_dashboard(",
        "@router.get(",
    )
    assert 'datetime.now(ZoneInfo("America/Mexico_City"))' in block
    assert 'fecha_ini = hoy.strftime(\'%Y-%m-%d\')' in block
    assert 'fecha_fin = hoy.strftime(\'%Y-%m-%d\')' in block


def test_sales_drilldown_hoy_uses_mexico_timezone():
    text = ROUTES.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    start = text.index("async def comercial_detalle_ventas_agrupado(")
    end = text.index('@router.get("/comercial/ticket-venta/{server_id}")', start)
    block = text[start:end]
    assert 'datetime.now(ZoneInfo("America/Mexico_City"))' in block
    assert 'if periodo == "dia":' in block
    assert "fecha_ini_dt = hoy_inicio" in block
    assert "merge_open_snapshot_tickets(" in block


def test_zoneinfo_import_is_present():
    text = ROUTES.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo" in text
